## Gain of cosmopolitan taxa/genes in irrigated and non-irrigated fields

## Clear workspace and set directory

```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/irrigation/Beta_diversity")
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load functional gene data

```{r}
#=====================Function=============================
ko01 <- read.csv("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Data/KOs.count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Data/Metadata.csv", header = TRUE)

set.seed(12345)

ko <- ko01[, meta$SampleID]

# 2. Define samples
irrigated_samples <- meta %>%
  filter(Irrigation == "irrigated") %>%
  pull(SampleID)

nonirrigated_samples <- meta %>%
  filter(Irrigation == "non-irrigated") %>%
  #sample_n(size = length(irrigated_samples), replace = FALSE) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

# 3. Presence/absence matrix
presence_matrix <- (ko > 0) * 1

# 4. Calculate occurrence in each system
ko_occ <- data.frame(
  KO = rownames(presence_matrix),
  irrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  irrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE])
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "shared",
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count == 0 ~ "unique_irrigated",
      irrigated_count == 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "unique_nonirrigated",
      TRUE ~ "absent"
    )
  )

table(ko_occ$Group)

# 5. Define cosmopolitan shared taxa
# Adjust threshold as needed
# For 75% prevalence with 22 samples: count >= 17
shared_KOs <- ko_occ %>%
  filter(irrigated_count > 17,  # 75% prevalence across non-irrigated samples
         nonirrigated_count > 17) %>%
  pull(KO)

length(shared_KOs)

# 6. Extract shared taxa presence/absence matrix
shared_pa <- presence_matrix[shared_KOs, , drop = FALSE]

# 7. Total taxa richness per farm
total_taxa_per_farm <- colSums(presence_matrix)

# 8. Farm-level recovery of shared/cosmopolitan taxa
farm_shared_recovery <- data.frame(
  SampleID = colnames(shared_pa),
  shared_number = colSums(shared_pa),
  shared_fraction_global = colSums(shared_pa) / length(shared_KOs),
  total_richness = total_taxa_per_farm[colnames(shared_pa)],
  shared_fraction_local = colSums(shared_pa) / total_taxa_per_farm[colnames(shared_pa)]) %>%
  left_join(meta %>% select(SampleID, Irrigation), by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(Irrigation = factor(
      Irrigation,
      levels = c("irrigated", "non-irrigated")))

head(farm_shared_recovery)

# 9. Statistical tests
wilcox.test(shared_number ~ Irrigation, data = farm_shared_recovery, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE) # W = 702.5, p-value = 0.1242
# The number of cosmopolitan KOs

wilcox.test(shared_fraction_global ~ Irrigation, data = farm_shared_recovery, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE) # W = 702.5, p-value = 0.1242
# The proportion of cosmopolitan KOs detected in each farmland sample relative to the total number of predefined shared KOs

wilcox.test(shared_fraction_local ~ Irrigation, data = farm_shared_recovery, exact = FALSE,correct = TRUE) # W = 741, p-value = 0.04629
# shared_fraction_local: Of all the KOs detected in each farm sample, the proportion belongs to the predefined 
# shared/cosmopolitan KOs, that is, the cosmopolitan KOs;
# More widely distributed shared KO events were detected in irrigated farmland, but the proportion of these KO events in the overall
# functional richness of the farmland did not increase significantly.


# 10. Summary statistics
farm_shared_recovery %>%
  group_by(Irrigation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shared_number = mean(shared_number),
    median_shared_number = median(shared_number),
    sd_shared_number = sd(shared_number),
    
    mean_shared_fraction_global = mean(shared_fraction_global),
    median_shared_fraction_global = median(shared_fraction_global),
    sd_shared_fraction_global = sd(shared_fraction_global),
    
    mean_total_richness = mean(total_richness),
    median_total_richness = median(total_richness),
    sd_total_richness = sd(total_richness),
    
    mean_shared_fraction_local = mean(shared_fraction_local),
    median_shared_fraction_local = median(shared_fraction_local),
    sd_shared_fraction_local = sd(shared_fraction_local),
    
    n = n(), .groups = "drop" )


# 11. Plot 1: number of cosmopolitan/shared taxa per farm
range(farm_shared_recovery$shared_number)

p_shared_number <- ggplot(farm_shared_recovery,
  aes(x = Irrigation, y = shared_number, color = Irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.10, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of cosmopolitan genes \n(75% prevalence) per farm",
    title = "Farm-level recovery of \n cosmopolitan (75% prevalence) genes") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7100, label = "Wilcoxon test: P = 0.124", size = 5) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_shared_number
ggsave("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Output/Cosmopolitan (0.75 prevalence)_genes_number_per_farm.pdf", p_shared_number, width = 5, height = 5.3)


# 12. Plot 2: fraction of all cosmopolitan taxa recovered per farm
p_shared_fraction_global <- ggplot(farm_shared_recovery,
      aes(x = Irrigation, y = shared_fraction_global, color = Irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.10, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of cosmopolitan genes \n(75% prevalence) recovered",
    title = "Recovery fraction of cosmopolitan genes \n(75% prevalence)") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.005, label = "Wilcoxon test: P = 0.124", size = 5) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_shared_fraction_global
ggsave("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Output/Cosmopolitan (0.75 prevalence)_genes_recovery_fraction_per_farm.pdf", p_shared_fraction_global, width = 5, height = 5.3)


# 13. Plot 3: fraction of each farm community composed of cosmopolitan taxa
range(farm_shared_recovery$shared_fraction_local)

p_shared_fraction_local <- ggplot(farm_shared_recovery,
  aes(x = Irrigation, y = shared_fraction_local, color = Irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of local community \n composed of cosmopolitan taxa",
    title = "Contribution of cosmopolitan genes (75% prevalence) \n to local communities") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.965, label = "Wilcoxon test: P = 0.046", size = 5) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_shared_fraction_local
ggsave("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Output/Cosmopolitan (0.75 prevalence)_genes_fraction_of_local_community.pdf", p_shared_fraction_local, width = 5, height = 5.3)

```

# 4. Calculate occurrence in each system

  nonirrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  irrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE])
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "shared",
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count == 0 ~ "unique_irrigated",
      irrigated_count == 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "unique_nonirrigated",
      TRUE ~ "absent"
    )
  )

table(ko_occ$Group)

# 5. Define cosmopolitan shared taxa
# Adjust threshold as needed
# For 75% prevalence with 22 samples: count >= 17
shared_KOs <- ko_occ %>%
  filter(irrigated_count > 17,  # 75% prevalence across non-irrigated samples
         nonirrigated_count > 17) %>%
  pull(KO)

length(shared_KOs)

# 6. Extract shared taxa presence/absence matrix
shared_pa <- presence_matrix[shared_KOs, , drop = FALSE]

# 7. Total taxa richness per farm
total_taxa_per_farm <- colSums(presence_matrix)

# 8. Farm-level recovery of shared/cosmopolitan taxa

  left_join(meta %>% select(SampleID, Irrigation), by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(Irrigation = factor(
    Irrigation,
    levels = c("irrigated", "non-irrigated")))

head(farm_shared_recovery)

# 9. Statistical tests
wilcox.test(shared_number ~ Irrigation, data = farm_shared_recovery, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE) # W = W = 765, p-value = 0.02281

wilcox.test(shared_fraction_global ~ Irrigation, data = farm_shared_recovery, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE) # W = 765, p-value = 0.02281

wilcox.test(shared_fraction_local ~ Irrigation, data = farm_shared_recovery, exact = FALSE,correct = TRUE) # W = 699, p-value = 0.1346


# 10. Summary statistics
farm_shared_recovery %>%
  group_by(Irrigation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_shared_number = mean(shared_number),

    mean_shared_number = mean(shared_number),
    median_shared_number = median(shared_number),
    sd_shared_number = sd(shared_number),
    
    mean_shared_fraction_global = mean(shared_fraction_global),
    median_shared_fraction_global = median(shared_fraction_global),
    sd_shared_fraction_global = sd(shared_fraction_global),
    
    mean_total_richness = mean(total_richness),
    median_total_richness = median(total_richness),
    sd_total_richness = sd(total_richness),
    
    mean_shared_fraction_local = mean(shared_fraction_local),
    median_shared_fraction_local = median(shared_fraction_local),
    sd_shared_fraction_local = sd(shared_fraction_local),
    
    n = n(), .groups = "drop"
  )


# 11. Plot 1: number of cosmopolitan/shared taxa per farm
range(farm_shared_recovery$shared_number)

p_shared_number <- ggplot(farm_shared_recovery,
                          aes(x = Irrigation, y = shared_number, color = Irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.10, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of cosmopolitan taxa per farm",
       title = "Farm-level recovery of \n cosmopolitan (100% prevalence) taxa") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 3970, label = "Wilcoxon test: P < 0.001", size = 5) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_shared_number
ggsave("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Output/Cosmopolitan (1.0 prevalence)_taxa_number_per_farm.pdf", p_shared_number, width = 5, height = 5.3)


# 12. Plot 2: fraction of all cosmopolitan taxa recovered per farm
p_shared_fraction_global <- ggplot(farm_shared_recovery,
                                   aes(x = Irrigation, y = shared_fraction_global, color = Irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.10, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of cosmopolitan taxa recovered",
       title = "Recovery fraction of cosmopolitan taxa") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.006, label = "Wilcoxon test: P < 0.001", size = 5) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_shared_fraction_global
ggsave("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Output/Cosmopolitan (1.0 prevalence)_taxa_recovery_fraction_per_farm.pdf", p_shared_fraction_global, width = 5, height = 5.3)


# 13. Plot 3: fraction of each farm community composed of cosmopolitan taxa
range(farm_shared_recovery$shared_fraction_local)

p_shared_fraction_local <- ggplot(farm_shared_recovery, aes(x = Irrigation, y = shared_fraction_local, color = Irrigation)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of local community \n composed of cosmopolitan taxa",
       title = "Contribution of cosmopolitan taxa (90% prevalence) \n to local communities") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.60, label = "Wilcoxon test: P = 0.347", size = 5) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_shared_fraction_local
ggsave("./Gain_of_cosmopolitan/Output/Cosmopolitan (1.0 prevalence)_taxa_fraction_of_local_community.pdf", p_shared_fraction_local, width = 5, height = 5.3)
